skill.name: plot-consistency-checker
skill.description: Reviews plot structure, story beats, logic flow, and narrative continuity to identify contradictions, plot holes, pacing issues, or unrealistic elements.
skill.summary: Checks narrative continuity and proposes fixes for plot, pacing, timeline, character, and world-rule issues.
skill.author: Amraha-Anwar

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the prompt-only skill. Manual review of SKILL.md found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable behavior.

content.value_statement: Story drafts can hide timeline gaps, weak motivations, and unresolved plot holes. This skill reviews narrative logic and returns clear fixes for continuity and pacing.
actual_capabilities: Requests plot summaries, chapter outlines, character arcs, and world-building rules when context is missing.
Checks cause-and-effect flow, timeline order, character motivation, and internal story rules.
Identifies plot holes, unexplained coincidences, inconsistent behavior, missing transitions, and pacing issues.
Explains each issue in clear language and proposes a correction for the affected story element.
Can provide an optional rewrite of the affected passage when the user asks for one.
limitations: Quality depends on the completeness of the plot materials provided by the user.
It cannot verify private canon or unwritten backstory that is not included in the prompt.
It does not replace a human editor for style, market fit, or final manuscript judgment.
It may miss subtle thematic conflicts when only a short summary is provided.

use_cases.title: Review a Novel Outline
use_cases.description: Find timeline gaps, weak transitions, and unresolved story beats before drafting chapters.

use_cases.title: Check Character Motivation
use_cases.description: Compare character actions against stated goals, conflicts, and emotional arcs.

use_cases.title: Audit World Rules
use_cases.description: Test whether magic, technology, politics, or setting rules stay consistent across scenes.
use_cases.target_user: Fantasy, science fiction, and speculative fiction authors

prompt_templates.title: Basic Plot Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a short plot summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this plot summary for contradictions, plot holes, and pacing issues. Return issues, explanations, and proposed fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Chapter Outline Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a chapter-by-chapter structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this chapter outline for cause-and-effect flow, missing transitions, and timeline problems. Suggest focused fixes for each issue.

prompt_templates.title: Character Arc Consistency
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review focused on motivation and behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the plot and character arcs together. Flag actions that conflict with motivation, growth, relationships, or known information.

prompt_templates.title: World Rules Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this plot against the stated world-building rules. Identify rule violations, unclear exceptions, and scenes needing stronger setup.

output_examples.input: A hero loses the only key in chapter three, then opens the sealed vault in chapter five without explanation.
output_examples.output: Issue: Vault access contradiction. Explanation: The plot removes the key, then uses it implicitly later. Proposed Fix: Add a recovered key, alternate access method, or earlier setup.

output_examples.input: A cautious character accepts a dangerous alliance immediately after warning others never to trust that group.
output_examples.output: Issue: Motivation shift lacks support. Explanation: The decision conflicts with established caution. Proposed Fix: Add pressure, new evidence, or a scene showing changed priorities.

output_examples.input: A magic system forbids healing magic, but the finale uses healing magic to resolve the main conflict.
output_examples.output: Issue: World rule violation. Explanation: The finale breaks a stated rule without setup. Proposed Fix: Create a limited exception or change the resolution.

best_practices: Provide the full plot summary and chapter outline when possible.
Include character goals, secrets, and known timeline constraints.
State world-building rules before asking for a consistency audit.
anti_patterns: Do not provide only a one-sentence premise and expect a full continuity audit.
Do not hide important backstory that explains a disputed plot event.
Do not ask for fixes without sharing the intended tone, genre, or target audience.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews plot structure, continuity, character motivation, pacing, transitions, and internal story rules.

faq.question: Can it find every plot hole?
faq.answer: No. It can only evaluate the story details included in the prompt or files.

faq.question: Does it rewrite scenes?
faq.answer: It can suggest an optional rewritten version of affected parts when the user requests rewriting.

faq.question: Is it useful before drafting?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review outlines before drafting to catch structural problems early.

faq.question: Can it review fantasy or science fiction rules?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the rules for magic, technology, politics, or setting constraints.

faq.question: Does it replace a human editor?
faq.answer: No. It supports early consistency review, but human editorial judgment remains important.
